[{"sha":"cea59032ae45ef8f282e22c5bf47c89e436c49b6","node_id":"C_kwDOBHnSpNoAKGNlYTU5MDMyYWU0NWVmOGYyODJlMjJjNWJmNDdjODllNDM2YzQ5YjY","commit":{"author":{"name":"Guillaume Chau","email":"guillaume.b.chau@gmail.com","date":"2026-10-24T19:09:44Z"},"committer":{"name":"Guillaume Chau","email":"guillaume.b.chau@gmail.com","date":"2026-10-24T19:09:44Z"},"message":"feat(benchmarks): add project explorer and code review workloads

Add two sectioned workloads modelled on explorer trees and diff viewers,
covering consumer patterns the other workloads avoid:

- `project-explorer`: project captions, branch and commit groups, and
  branch/commit rows, each kind its own component; expansion, project
  filter, updates, selection, deep jump.
- `code-review`: continuous unified diff with file headers, hunk headers
  and syntax-highlighted lines rendered through `v-html`; deep jump, file
  filter, updates, viewed marking.

Both share one renderer with a per-kind `v-if` switch pooled by
`type-field="kind"`, an inline `item-size` resolver, and a sticky caption
overlay derived from the scroll offset in the list component, so every
scroll event re-renders it. Plain mode shares the same component, overlay
and scroll handler. Overlay copies carry no record attributes, so the
existing correctness checks apply
